Reem Glasco, LPC-S

Reem Glasco is a Licensed Professional Counselor Supervisor in Texas, license 66562, and has held supervisor status since 2009 with over fifteen years of clinical experience. She is a NARM therapist, a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner (SEP), EMDR certified and an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. She was a Clinical Partner at Capital Area Counseling from 2021 to 2025 and practices from Austin, Texas, working online statewide.

How I work

My NARM approach is an invitation to be curious about your patterns, and about how they keep you from being present in your own life. Where did I learn this? How was it serving me? How does being present give me a choice about which path leads to thriving?

My EMDR work is IFS-informed, which means the protective parts of you get consulted before anything gets processed, and my emphasis is on phases one and two where that agreement is built. It is weighted toward stabilization: acute stress, ongoing stress, overwhelm, loss. My Somatic Experiencing approach meets shock trauma in a titrated way, slow and gentle, building your window of tolerance rather than testing it.

I teach effortless self care through walk and mindful therapy, and I run mindful trail retreats for interns, associates and therapists, where we explore being present and what gets in the way of it.

I am also an LPC supervisor. Supervision is online, and I offer mindful retreats for associate therapists to expand their personal and professional awareness in the field.

You can also find me on Psychology Today.
